cues.en: Hi and welcome to this video series where we're going to talk about Microsoft Foundry.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到介紹 Microsoft Foundry 的影片系列。

cues.en: In this part one we will start with a high-level overview what it is and then we'll dive into the various topics in
cues.zh: 第一部分會先從整體概觀開始，了解它是什麼，再於，

cues.en: subsequent videos.
cues.zh: 後續影片深入各個主題。

cues.en: So let's get started.
cues.zh: 我們開始吧。

cues.en: So if I could only give you a single sentence of what this is, it would be this.
cues.zh: 如果只能用一句話介紹，那就是：

cues.en: Microsoft's one-stop shop for all things AI.
cues.zh: Microsoft 為各種 AI 需求提供的一站式平台。

cues.en: As in a company is able to manage, develop all their AI solution in a single
cues.zh: 讓企業能在單一入口網站中管理與開發所有 AI 解決方案，

cues.en: portal with Microsoft's known expertise in enterprise stuff like compliance and governance.
cues.zh: 結合 Microsoft 在法遵、治理等企業功能上的經驗。

cues.en: Before we go into the offerings, let's quickly have a look at the history and rebranding that led to Microsoft Foundry.
cues.zh: 在介紹功能前，先看看它一路發展與改名的歷史。

cues.en: What Foundry is today started out as something called Microsoft Cognitive Services.
cues.zh: 今天的 Foundry，最早叫做 Microsoft Cognitive Services。

cues.en: This was back in the early days of AI where vision, speech and language capabilities were the thing.
cues.zh: 當時 AI 主要是視覺、語音與語言處理。

cues.en: It was before GEN-AI.
cues.zh: 還沒有生成式 AI。

cues.en: You will still see the Cognitive Service name popping up in various technical things, permissions and so on in the day.
cues.zh: 現在技術設定、權限等地方，仍然常見 Cognitive Services 這個名稱。

cues.en: But after the moment happened in November 2022, everything was suddenly AI.
cues.zh: 但 2022 年十一月的轉折之後，AI 突然成為所有產品的重心。

cues.en: So Cognitive Service was rebranded to Azure AI Services.
cues.zh: 因此 Cognitive Services 改名為 Azure AI Services。

cues.en: And this is where we got the Azure OpenAI Service, which we also have as a NuGet package today.
cues.zh: 也在這時推出 Azure OpenAI Service，現在也有對應的 NuGet 套件。

cues.en: And we still use that if we want to work with individual modules in the Microsoft Foundry.
cues.zh: 如果要直接操作 Foundry 裡的個別功能，目前仍會使用它。

cues.en: The next years was the maturity phase of AI.
cues.zh: 接下來幾年，是 AI 逐漸成熟的階段。

cues.en: And back then, everything just happened in the Azure portal as services.
cues.zh: 當時所有服務都在 Azure 入口網站中管理。

cues.en: But in Build 2025, the Azure AI Foundry was introduced, which was for a very brief
cues.zh: 到了 Build 2025，推出 Azure AI Foundry；它曾短暫，

cues.en: time also called the Azure OpenAI Foundry.
cues.zh: 被稱為 Azure OpenAI Foundry。

cues.en: But this shifted to this one-stop mentality, more models than just OpenAI, and it became
cues.zh: 接著轉向一站式平台，不再只有 OpenAI，也提供更多模型，

cues.en: a dedicated portal on ai.azure.com.
cues.zh: 並在 ai.azure.com 建立專屬入口網站。

cues.en: So here we don't just have model services, but we also have persistent agents that was hosted directly in the portal and could be
cues.zh: 因此除了模型服務，也加入直接託管在平台上的持續性代理程式，

cues.en: controlled and managed like most enterprise companies demanded.
cues.zh: 可以依照企業需求管理與控制。

cues.en: And finally, in November 2025, at the Microsoft Ignite Conference, we saw the latest rebranding with the name switching from Azure AI Foundry to
cues.zh: 最後在 2025 年十一月 Microsoft Ignite，再次從 Azure AI Foundry 改名為，

cues.en: Microsoft Foundry.
cues.zh: Microsoft Foundry。

cues.en: Together with this name change, there was also a kind of V2 of the portal where
cues.zh: 配合這次改名，也推出第二版入口網站，

cues.en: the services got more evolved and workflows was introduced.
cues.zh: 服務更加完整，並加入工作流程。

cues.en: As of this recording in December 2025, the new V2 portal of the Microsoft Foundry is still in preview.
cues.zh: 截至這支影片錄製時，也就是 2025 年十二月，Foundry 第二版入口網站仍在預覽。

cues.en: So you can still switch back and forward, but the new portal is the future.
cues.zh: 所以還能切回舊版，但新版才是未來方向。

cues.en: And it looks like this.
cues.zh: 新版看起來是這樣。

cues.en: And this is what we're going to go walk through in the rest of this video.
cues.zh: 這也是接下來要逐步介紹的介面。

cues.en: In the new portal, there are three main sections, Discovery, Build, and Operate, which you access from the top right.
cues.zh: 新版有三個主要區域：Discover、Build 與 Operate，從右上角切換。

cues.en: Discovery is a gallery of what models and tools the Foundry portal offers.
cues.zh: Discover 是模型與工具的目錄。

cues.en: As of this recording, there are 11,251 models, which you can choose.
cues.zh: 錄影當下，共有 11,251 個模型可供選擇。

cues.en: And this is an impressive number, but in reality, most of them are actually from Huggingface, like 10,800 of them.
cues.zh: 數量很驚人，但其中約一萬零八百個其實來自 Hugging Face。

cues.en: Azure themselves only host 77 models, which is still a lot.
cues.zh: Azure 自己託管的只有七十七個，不過也已經很多。

cues.en: And in the agent capabilities, only 43 of those work together with the agent capabilities.
cues.zh: 能與代理程式功能整合的，則只有四十三個。

cues.en: And that is mostly the OpenAI models and the ones that use the same OpenAI spec.
cues.zh: 主要是 OpenAI，以及採用相同 OpenAI 規格的模型。

cues.en: There are various info on each model, and there's comparison features in the gallery that helps you pick and choose the one model that
cues.zh: 每個模型都有資訊，也能透過比較功能，選擇，

cues.en: fits you the best.
cues.zh: 最適合自己的模型。

cues.en: Discovery also have various tools that they can use together with agents.
cues.zh: Discover 也列出能搭配代理程式使用的工具。

cues.en: Again, they have an impressive 1,451 different tools.
cues.zh: 同樣有很驚人的數量，共 1,451 種。

cues.en: Most of them are, however, classical logic app connectors.
cues.zh: 不過多數其實是傳統 Logic Apps 連接器。

cues.en: But more interesting, there's various MCP tools, and there's also the ability to make your own tools.
cues.zh: 比較有趣的是 MCP 工具，也能建立自訂工具。

cues.en: Finally, in the Discovery section are 14 solution templates, which is our various GitHub repo samples.
cues.zh: 最後還有十四個解決方案範本，連到不同的 GitHub 範例儲存庫。

cues.en: Most of them are in Python, but there's a few of them in C-sharp.
cues.zh: 大部分使用 Python，但也有少數 C#。

cues.en: Next, we have the build section, which is the most interesting for developers.
cues.zh: 接著是開發者最感興趣的 Build 區域。

cues.en: In here, we have agents, which is persistent agents where we can create one or more of them using either the GUI or create
cues.zh: 裡面有 Agents，可以透過介面或程式碼，建立一個或多個，

cues.en: it in code.
cues.zh: 持續存在的代理程式。

cues.en: You can then add skills, knowledge, and memory to them, and you can leverage them using code, or you can publish them to Microsoft
cues.zh: 再加入技能、知識與記憶；能透過程式使用，也能發布到 Microsoft，

cues.en: Copilot or Microsoft Teams.
cues.zh: Copilot 或 Microsoft Teams。

cues.en: We will cover agents in much more details in subsequent parts of this series.
cues.zh: 後續影片會更深入介紹代理程式。

cues.en: You also have in the build section the newest addition to Foundry, which is workflows.
cues.zh: Build 裡最新加入的功能是 Workflows。

cues.en: Workflows is simply just multiple agents stringed together in a set of steps in order to
cues.zh: 工作流程就是把多個代理程式依照步驟串接，

cues.en: solve more complex tasks.
cues.zh: 解決更複雜的任務。

cues.en: We'll again have details in a later part of this series.
cues.zh: 這也會在後續影片介紹。

cues.en: The build section also has the model section, but not as a gallery, but more what models you have actually deployed in order to
cues.zh: Build 也有 Models，但不是模型目錄，而是實際已部署、用來，

cues.en: use the agents.
cues.zh: 支援代理程式的模型。

cues.en: So you can either use these models you deploy in the agents or directly in your code without agents.
cues.zh: 這些模型可以供代理程式使用，也能不透過代理程式，直接從程式呼叫。

cues.en: It is also here you control how the model is hosted, what throughput it has, what version it has, and so on.
cues.zh: 也在這裡控制託管方式、吞吐量、版本等設定。

cues.en: Next up is fine tuning, and this is if you need that, you can perform a
cues.zh: 接著是 Fine-tuning，如果需要，可以針對，

cues.en: subset of fine tuning on certain models.
cues.zh: 部分支援的模型進行微調。

cues.en: You will need to provide some training data for the fine tuning, and then deploy that fine-tuned model yourself.
cues.zh: 要先提供訓練資料，再自行部署微調後的模型。

cues.en: We will not cover fine-tuning in this series, as it's very rarely used and is only a sort of last resort for very,
cues.zh: 這個系列不會介紹微調，因為它很少用，通常只是非常，

cues.en: very niche and specialised scenarios.
cues.zh: 特殊且專門情境下的最後手段。

cues.en: Next up we have tools, knowledge, and data.
cues.zh: 接著是 Tools、Knowledge 與 Data。

cues.en: These are essentially just where you create and define the capabilities of agents.
cues.zh: 基本上是在這裡建立並定義代理程式的能力。

cues.en: So for example, you define an MCP server or you hook up to a vector store as a knowledge, and that is the configurations
cues.zh: 例如指定 MCP 伺服器，或把向量儲存區當成知識來源，這些設定，

cues.en: that you then hook up to your agents.
cues.zh: 再接到代理程式上。

cues.en: The final two entries in the build sections are evaluation and guardrails.
cues.zh: Build 最後兩個項目是 Evaluation 與 Guardrails。

cues.en: Evaluations being that you can add some data sets to your models that you can train them against.
cues.zh: Evaluation 讓你加入資料集，評估模型。

cues.en: So you can make a model or an agent, you give it the training set, you tweak your code and your agents, and you
cues.zh: 建立模型或代理程式後，提供測試資料，再調整程式與代理程式，

cues.en: see if it becomes better or worse, and if there's handle of the quality and security at the time.
cues.zh: 觀察品質變好或變差，以及安全性是否符合需求。

cues.en: Finally, guardrails allows you to guard against certain uses of an agent like sexual content, self -harm, hate speech, and so on.
cues.zh: Guardrails 則用來限制某些內容，例如色情、自傷、仇恨言論等。

cues.en: So if you have certain use cases that deviate from the out-of-the-box default guardrails, it could for example be that you
cues.zh: 如果某些使用情境需要不同於預設的限制，例如，

cues.en: had a medical AI that need to have certain words be allowed in certain areas that would perhaps hit sexual content or hate content
cues.zh: 醫療 AI 可能必須允許某些專業詞彙，而它們平常可能觸發色情或仇恨內容的篩選，

cues.en: and so on.
cues.zh: 就能調整。

cues.en: While it could also be that you want to have them even more strict, like for example, in a kid's app where you want
cues.zh: 也可以比預設更嚴格，例如兒童應用程式，

cues.en: to block certain things in a higher level of detail than the defaults.
cues.zh: 希望更細緻地封鎖某些內容。

cues.en: The final section in Microsoft Foundry is the operate part.
cues.zh: Microsoft Foundry 最後一個主要區域是 Operate。

cues.en: This is where you control all the individual parts of agents, tool, knowledge, and so on.
cues.zh: 這裡管理代理程式、工具、知識等各個元件。

cues.en: Because behind the scenes, they are still Azure services, blob storage, databases, and so on.
cues.zh: 因為它們背後仍然是 Azure 服務、Blob 儲存體與資料庫。

cues.en: You also can see a lot of stats in here and control quotas and user access
cues.zh: 也能查看許多統計資料，以及管理額度與使用者，

cues.en: control in all the control parts and control planes of the Foundry portal.
cues.zh: 存取控制等 Foundry 的管理功能。

cues.en: So this is everything in this video.
cues.zh: 這支影片就介紹到這裡。

cues.en: In the next videos, we will primarily dive into the build section, where we will go from just knowing the portal now to actually building something on top of it.
cues.zh: 後續主要深入 Build，從認識入口網站，進一步開始建立實際功能。

cues.en: So see you now.
cues.zh: 我們下次見。
